queries.title: Search phrases
queries.description: One or more keyword phrases. Each phrase is searched once and gives its own rows.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max videos per phrase
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Stop after this many videos for each phrase. Paging follows the page's own continuation token.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: relevance keeps YouTube's own order; views puts the most watched first. YouTube ignores date and rating sorting here, so they are not offered; use uploadDate for fresh videos.

uploadDate.title: Uploaded within
uploadDate.description: Restrict the page to recent videos. This is the honest way to get fresh results, because the endpoint ignores date sorting.

videoDuration.title: Video length
videoDuration.description: Filter by length: short is under 4 minutes, long is over 20.

region.title: Region
region.description: Two letter country code that shapes the result mix, for example US, DE or UA.

language.title: Language
language.description: Two letter language code for titles and labels, for example en or de.
